promotions_code_lower_unique.name: promotions_code_lower_unique
promotions_code_lower_unique.where: "promotions"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

promotions_url_slug_unique.name: promotions_url_slug_unique
promotions_url_slug_unique.where: "promotions"."url_slug" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

promotions_scope_id_match_chk.name: promotions_scope_id_match_chk
promotions_scope_id_match_chk.value: ("promotions"."scope" = 'cart' AND "promotions"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."scope" <> 'cart' AND "promotions"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

promotions_trigger_surface_chk.name: promotions_trigger_surface_chk
promotions_trigger_surface_chk.value: ("promotions"."trigger_kind" = 'auto' AND "promotions"."code" IS NULL AND "promotions"."url_slug" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."trigger_kind" = 'code' AND "promotions"."code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("promotions"."trigger_kind" = 'url' AND "promotions"."url_slug" IS NOT NULL)

promotions_schedule_order_chk.name: promotions_schedule_order_chk
promotions_schedule_order_chk.value: "promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"
